integrity: Original proof gives a sparse-interval lemma and a sharp numerical threshold. Exact-integer checks corroborate one nine-ray witness but do not certify universal statements. Historical novelty is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic zero, smooth complete toric surfaces, blow-up at open-torus identity. The general proof invokes the published Laface–Ugaglia three-ray criterion; not a classification of all nine-ray failures or higher-multiplicity generators.
title: The sharp nine-ray threshold for multiplicity-one Cox rings of smooth toric point blow-ups
